title: Booleanization recovers a bit from its field value
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $b \in \mathrm{Fin}\,2$ be a bit. Booleanizing the field value of $b$ recovers $b$: taking the element of $\bbz/p$ represented by $b$ and then mapping it back to $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ (sending $1$ to $1$ and everything else to $0$) yields $b$ again.
hypotheses_covered: b is a bit in Fin 2
replaced:
Applying $\mathrm{bitify}_p$ to $\mathrm{boolVal}_p(b)$ returns the original bit $b$, for every
$b : \mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
